Theorem
[Weak maximum principle] ↗ def:uniform-ellipticity ↗ def:divergence-nondivergence-form ↗ thm:boundary-h2-regularity 1. ch6:6.4-thm-1\group Maximum Principles

Assume $u \in C^2(U) \cap C(\bar U)$ and \[ c \equiv 0 \quad \text{in } U. \]

(i) If \[ Lu \leq 0 \quad \text{in } U, \] then \[ \max _{\bar U} u = \max _{\partial U} u. \]

(ii) If \[ Lu \geq 0 \quad \text{in } U, \] then \[ \min _{\bar U} u = \min _{\partial U} u. \]

Proof

\sketch At a strict interior maximum, $Du=0$ and $D^2u$ is negative semidefinite; diagonalizing the positive coefficient matrix gives $Lu\ge 0$, contradicting $Lu<0$. For the nonstrict case perturb by $\varepsilon e^{\lambda x_1}$ with $\lambda $ large and let $\varepsilon \downarrow 0$; apply the result to $-u$ for minima.

□
